newsitem.title: UK: TLG up as report highlights director buying.
newsitem.headline: TLG up as report highlights director buying.

text.p: Shares in lighting group TLG Plc rose on Monday after a report in the Sunday Times highlighted recent director share purchases and said other investors "should consider buying in."
The stock, which has languished since the company's profit warning in September, was up 6-1/2p at 105 by 1232 GMT.
The Sunday Times said TLG chairman Hamish Bryce had bought 40,000 shares at 115p, signalling confidence in its future, though Bryce's purchase took place in October.
More recently TLG said on December 9 that non-executive driector Hubertus Krossa had bought 6,459 shares at 105p.
